exposure: participation preferences regarding nutrition education programs
preferred content of nutrition education programs
preferred format of nutrition education programs
outcome: Likelihood to attend future nutrition education programs
Preferred content topics for nutrition education
cohort: The cohort consisted of 70 Asian Indian fathers living in South Florida, who had children aged 6-11 years.
finding: Almost half of the Asian Indian fathers surveyed were likely to attend future nutrition education programs, with a strong preference for online delivery modes and interest in content covering healthy diets for children, encouraging healthy choices, vegetarian options, and age-specific nutrition.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from fathers of children aged 6-11 years at the time of the survey.
